title: Western Union (WU) Ends Acquisition Fight And Heads To Court Over Collapsed Deal
summary: Western Union (NYSE:WU) has ended its planned acquisition of International Money Express after a dispute with California regulators. The terminated deal has triggered a legal clash between Western Union and Intermex, with both sides preparing for court action. California authorities raised regulatory objections that the parties were unable to resolve before closing, leading to the collapse of the transaction.
